DISHWASHING MADE EASY

Assuming you spend between 10 or 15 minutes hand washing the dishes each night, that means you will spend an average of around 75 hours per year doing the dishes. Over the course of the average adult lifetime, that works out to be more than half a year spent washing dishes.
Countertop Dishwashers help you save time,If you don't have much space in your kitchen, but you're tired of spending your evenings cleaning up after meals, then these Countertop Dishwashers will be of great choice.

GETTING THE MOST OUT OF YOUR DISHWASHER

1.Avoid loading your dishwasher without cleaning plates that still have large pieces of food on them. Large, solid pieces of food can clog your dishwasher drain.
2.Cleaning off large pieces of food also reduces the chance of permanent, caked-on dirt.
3.Not everything goes in the dishwasher. You may ruin delicate items that aren’t meant for the dishwasher, or cause them to break inside the appliance.
4.Load cups upside down, or you'll get a cup full of (probably dirty) hot water at the end of a wash cycle
5.Keep fragile items apart, so they don't clink and break one another.

GETTING THE MOST OUT OF YOUR DISHWASHER

Quiet Operatoin

The kitchen is one of the noisiest rooms in the home. But it doesn t have to be. Samsung turns the kitchen s chief noisemaker into a gentle peacemaker. Leakage Protection

Did you know that a dishwasher can quietly, secretly sabotage your home? Hard-to-find leaks can cause extensive damage to your kitchen floor and, if you live in a multi-unit building, even affect the home below yours. That s why the Samsung dishwasher is equipped with a unique Digital Leakage Sensor designed to detect even the smallest traces of water. Located below the dishwasher, the sensor immediately shuts off the electrical connection after detecting a leak saving you from the expensive aftermath of a water-related emergency.

Twister Nozzle to Assure your Dishes are Always Clean

Samsung s exclusive twister nozzle system gets every dish extra clean. A unique and dramatic upgrade from the traditional straight-line nozzle system, the twister s powerful rotating effect whips water onto and into more of each dish maximizing our dishwasher s cleaning performance. Just imagine Mother Nature summoning up the cleaning tornado inside the machine so that your dishes come out perfectly clean. Our engineers did.

3 Level Tine Holder gives more flexibility

You don t cook the same meals every day, so you don t use the same dishes everyday either. Samsung s new blue cap 3-level tine holder lets you fold tines at an angle ideally suited to each dish. With tines that stretch 40mm longer than typical tines and convenient tine caps, adjusting them to your daily needs is a breeze.

How To Diamond Paint:
1. Understand how to read the canvas. The canvas is composed of tiny boxes that are colored and labeled with numbers. Each number corresponds to a diamond color. The numbers are written on a chart, with the corresponding bag and diamond color written below or next to it. The chart is printed on the side of the canvas.

2. Unroll the canvas and tape it down onto a flat surface. The canvas is covered with a protective plastic film. The chart area is sticky if you peel back this plastic film. It’s recommended that you do not remove the entire piece of plastic film at once. Instead, start from the bottom, work your way up, slowly peel back the film.

3. Look at the chart and determine which color of diamond to use. Put the diamonds in the tray. It’s recommended to work with one color at a time. Position the diamonds with the flat side down by slightly shaking the tray.

4. Dip the tip of the applicator pen into the gel. The gel will enable you to pick up the diamonds.

5. Gently press the tip of the applicator pen to the rounded side of the diamond.

6. Peel back the plastic film to uncover the area you are working on and carefully press the diamond onto the symbol box.

➤Repeat Steps 4-6 until your design is completed.

description:
Quiet Operatoin

The kitchen is one of the noisiest rooms in the home. But it doesn t have to be. Samsung turns the kitchen s chief noisemaker into a gentle peacemaker. Leakage Protection

Did you know that a dishwasher can quietly, secretly sabotage your home? Hard-to-find leaks can cause extensive damage to your kitchen floor and, if you live in a multi-unit building, even affect the home below yours. That s why the Samsung dishwasher is equipped with a unique Digital Leakage Sensor designed to detect even the smallest traces of water. Located below the dishwasher, the sensor immediately shuts off the electrical connection after detecting a leak saving you from the expensive aftermath of a water-related emergency.

Twister Nozzle to Assure your Dishes are Always Clean

Samsung s exclusive twister nozzle system gets every dish extra clean. A unique and dramatic upgrade from the traditional straight-line nozzle system, the twister s powerful rotating effect whips water onto and into more of each dish maximizing our dishwasher s cleaning performance. Just imagine Mother Nature summoning up the cleaning tornado inside the machine so that your dishes come out perfectly clean. Our engineers did.

3 Level Tine Holder gives more flexibility

You don t cook the same meals every day, so you don t use the same dishes everyday either. Samsung s new blue cap 3-level tine holder lets you fold tines at an angle ideally suited to each dish. With tines that stretch 40mm longer than typical tines and convenient tine caps, adjusting them to your daily needs is a breeze.

description:
The 8194001 Door Balance Link Kit by PartsBroz contains two wheel and mount assemblies (also called roller assemblies) and two link cables. These components connect the door spring to the dishwasher door, making it easy to open and close the dishwasher. If any component breaks, your dishwasher door won’t close properly. Replace all four components with the Door Balance Link Kit by PartsBroz. It’s durable, affordable, and easy to install.

Installing this door balance link kit can fix the following problems:

  • Dishwasher is noisy;
  • Door won’t close;
  • Door latch failure.

Installation Tips

Before beginning the repair, unplug your dishwasher from its power source and disconnect its supply lines. You must replace both sets of assemblies and link cables at the same time. Recommended tools include a Philips screwdriver, 5/16-in. nut driver, a towel, and a 5/8-in. wrench.

Whirlpool: WDT910SAYE2, WDT910SAYE3, WDT910SAYH0, WDT910SAYH1, WDT910SAYH2, WDT910SAYH3, WDT910SAYM0, WDT910SAYM1.

SENS:
The sens dial determines the detecting range of motion sensor. Rotating the dial clockwise will extend the distance.(max 40 ft)
TIME:
The time dial determines the duration of time the light will stay illuminated after motion has been detected.

LUX:
This is the level of darkness reached before the light turns on.

If set to minimum level, the sensor will only trigger when it's dark. This is the most idea position.

If you’re tired of sudsy hands, soggy towels, and soapy sponges, then this compact but mighty portable dishwasher is the perfect way to solve dish dilemmas in kitchens everywhere and set your hands free!

Spacious Interior
The spacious interior provides enough room for 4 place settings, and can even accommodate dinner plates up to 12 inches when loaded at an angle. The slide-out storage rack and removable cutlery basket make for easy loading and unloading.

Water-Saving
This compact dishwasher utilizes just 1.3 gallons (5 liters) of water in a normal wash cycle, which is at least 80% less water than washing by hand.

Easy to Use
Thanks to its built-in water tank, this device allows for easy, convenient use without a permanent water connection required. A water inlet hose is also included for direct water supply from a kitchen faucet. (A faucet adapter may be needed).

See-Through Door
The transparent dual-layer glass door, combined with a built-in LED lamp, allows you to easily and clearly check the dishwasher's working status. 5 Wash Cycles
This countertop dishwasher supports 5 wash cycles and a Dry mode, which can easily be programmed and monitored via the LED control panel. A 60-minute automatic air drying is added to every washing mode other than the Fruit mode.

Dry Mode for Storage
After the wash cycle is finished, the Dry mode will provide extra 60 minutes of drying to the dishes. In the next 3 days, 15-minute automatic ventilation will run every 75 minutes. The Dry mode can be used with any washing mode other than Fruit mode, and can also be turned on separately.
